summary: PHP SDK lacks conflict token retry loop for schedule updates. The server now returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors (per temporal/temporal#8474), but the SDK doesn't implement retry logic to handle these errors.
userImpact: Users cannot reliably update schedules when concurrent updates occur, as the SDK doesn't retry on conflict token mismatches returned by the server.
rootCause: PHP SDK lacks conflict token retry loop for schedule updates, while server now returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors per temporal/temporal#8474
proposedFix: Implement retry loop for schedule updates that handles 'mismatched conflict token' responses from server
workaround: Manually retry schedule update operations in application code when conflict token mismatch errors occur
keyQuote: The server returns 'mismatched conflict token' as of https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/8474
